title: Correct substack TOC/READMEs; surface Pillar 25 SynBio extension as Post 27.a
body:
`post-97-synthetic-biology-attractor-engineering.md` existed on disk but was absent from the substack README/TOC entirely. Test counts in posts 27 and 28 were stale (pre-SynBio). The `.a`/`.b` naming convention had not been applied.

## Changes

**`substack/README.md`**
- Added `post-97-…` to the Publishing Order table immediately after Post 27, labelled **Post 27.a** ("Publish after Post 27") — the natural slot for a Pillar 25 extension
- Added a dedicated **Post 27.a** section (source-documents table, description) replacing what would have been a confusing "Post 97" label that conflicts with the existing "Posts 97–98" section (GW Yukawa / Pillars 97–98)
- Extended the Post 27 source-row to include `src/genetics/synthetic_biology.py`
- Both tagline occurrences: `15,072 tests` → `15,100 tests`

**`post-97-synthetic-biology-attractor-engineering.md`**
- Header: `# Post 97:` → `# Post 27.a:` for consistency with the TOC label

**`post-27-genetics-evolution.md`**
- New **Synthetic Biology: Deliberate Attractor Engineering** section: 10-row UM↔SynBio mapping table, biosecurity/HILS note, cross-reference to Post 27.a
- Footer: `78 tests` → `141 tests`; `15,023` → `15,100` total tests; `synthetic_biology.py` added to source list

**`post-28-materials-science.md`**
- Footer: `15,023` → `15,100` total tests

**`substack/BOOKS_README.md`**
- Added **v7.0 — SynBio Edition** to version history: post-27.a, 63 new tests (141 total in `test_genetics.py`), biosecurity HILS, 15,100 total tests
